about.title: Moving Made Simple. Built with Care.
about.subtitle: Your premier moving partner in Maastricht, Limburg and beyond.
about.mission_text:
moveit Maastricht is on a mission to provide a Michelin-star moving experience at a student-friendly price.

We believe moving should feel organized, transparent and stress-free — not chaotic and overwhelming.

From the first WhatsApp message or quote request until the final box is placed, we focus on delivering a smooth customer experience built around communication, punctuality and genuine care.

Whether you are a student, jonge professional, family or expat, our goal is simple: to make moving feel easier, safer and more human.
about.vision_text:
To become the most trusted and customer-focused moving company in Maastricht and Limburg.

We aim to set a new standard for moving services by combining affordability, modern communication, reliability and exceptional customer care.

moveit wants to become the go-to moving company for students, residents and businesses across the region — and eventually expand throughout the Netherlands and beyond.
about.story_text:
moveit Maastricht was created after seeing a clear gap in the moving industry: customers often felt stressed, unheard and treated like “just another booking.”

One of moveit’s founders previously helped build another successful moving company in Maastricht. Through that experience, he realized that what customers remember most is not just the transport itself — but how they were treated throughout the journey.

That realization became the foundation of moveit.

The idea was simple: build a moving company where customer experience comes first.

Today, moveit combines professional moving services with a modern, friendly and highly communicative approach. We focus on transparency, fast communication, careful handling and being genuinely present for customers during one of the most stressful moments in life: moving.
why_moveit_text: Moving is one of those moments in life people never really forget.
Especially in a city like Maastricht, where people from all over the world arrive to study, work, build careers and start new chapters.
moveit was built around one simple idea: moving should feel less stressful and more hopeful.
The name “moveit” reflects energy, momentum and progress. Not just physically moving boxes — but helping people move forward in life.
We wanted something simple, international and easy to remember. A name that feels active, modern and positive in any language.
Because whether you’re moving across Maastricht, relocating within Limburg or starting a completely new chapter somewhere else in Europe — you’re not just changing addresses.
And we believe that experience deserves care, communication and people you can trust.

how_it_works.step3_desc: Once their move is completed, you will receive a €20 cash reward as a thank you!

form.title: Invite a Friend Today

faq.title: Referral FAQ
faq.q1: When do I receive my €20 reward?
faq.a1: You will receive your reward within 14 days after your friend's move has been successfully completed and paid for.
faq.q2: Is there a limit to how many friends I can refer?
faq.a2: No! You can refer as many friends as you like. There is no cap on your rewards.
